name: Enterprise Data Landscape and Analytical Lineage View

conditionalDependencies.condition: Report / Statement publication specification becomes available
Perimeter edition and scope semantics are reconciled

constraints: Data Landscape is an issued-at, version-pinned snapshot projection and Analytical Lineage View is a WM-DAT-006 profile; neither mints subject identity.
A published projection uses an existing WM-DAT-008 Data Product identity; a reusable handle owns no lineage edge.
Issued-at and as-of are distinct required pins; issued-at binds an immutable observed set.
Definitions remain disjoint from observations, issues, runs, studies and claims; corrections and retries append successors and never amend released artifacts in place.
Every lineage edge records type, granularity, capture method, producer, confidence and evidence; both endpoints are version- or partition-addressed.
Inference-derived edges use captureMethod inferred and cannot establish absence, comparability or direct derivation.
Impact results contain four labelled sets: affected definitions, affected issues or runs, affected findings or claims, and unresolved coverage; flat unclassified results are invalid.

Comparability reconciles formula or method, unit and code-system version, population, dimensions and null policy using comparable, comparable-with-restatement or non-comparable; a missing verdict defaults to non-comparable.
A report issue pins definition versions, parameters, period, cutoff, as-of, issued-at, input versions or partitions and digests, and run reference.
A live dashboard is citable only through a frozen successor report issue.
Missing edges mean unobserved unless a closed, scoped, time-bounded, edition-pinned completeness perimeter covers the issued projection's exact observed set.
Freshness evaluates schema, classification, cohort or privacy, and snapshot states relative to issued-at.
Run success proves neither quality, freshness, publication, acceptance nor fitness.
A superseded WM-XCT-003 crosswalk marks the issued projection stale; mappings are never silently re-resolved.
Unknown, zero, not-applicable, missing and suppressed remain distinct gap classes.
Dependent findings and conclusions must retain stale-input and incomplete-input markers and are never rewritten.
Findings retain scope, assumptions, defeaters and evidence; association never auto-promotes to causation.
The issued projection pins source-rights policy version and fingerprint; policy re-evaluation creates a successor and never mutates the issue.
Withheld segments remain marked withheld and require cohort or privacy controls against recovery by differencing.

Metric-facing validation is gated on EM-DAT-05 registry allocation; report validation is gated on WM-REC-002 publication; perimeter absence validation is gated on reconciled WM-DAT-006 perimeter semantics.
holds: Metric Definition remains identifier-unassigned under EM-DAT-05.
WM-REC-002 is conditional and has no published specification.
WM-DAT-006 completeness-perimeter semantics and source-version divergences require reconciliation.
Pipeline run or task-attempt and analysis-method mastership are not covered by the resolved bases.
All target bases remain non-canonical reviewable drafts and relation rows remain candidate.
